name: agy-imagegen
description: Generate images with Gemini through the Antigravity CLI (agy), headlessly, and save them where you want.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images with Gemini via the Antigravity CLI
interface.longDescription: Turns a text description into an image file by driving the Antigravity CLI (agy) headlessly. No permission bypass and no window automation: agy generates the image and a wrapper script copies it to the path you choose, converting between PNG, JPEG, BMP and GIF if needed. Windows + PowerShell; requires agy installed and signed in.
defaultPrompt: Generate an image of a red fox in a snowy forest, watercolor style.
Make a flat vector logo for my coffee shop.
Draw a cozy cabin at night and save it to my Pictures folder.
